literature.headline_zh: SARS-CoV-2本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期SARS-CoV-2研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在总体队列研究中,接种疫苗的患者病毒清除时间显著短于未接种疫苗的患者(9.05 vs 10.42天;P < .001)。匹配后的队列研究包括228例未接种疫苗者、228例灭活疫苗接种者和114例Ad5-nCoV接种者。各组的病毒清除中位时间分别为9.42天、8.56天和8.48天。 [10.1080/21645515.2026.2731694]
对于RSV和流感,临床样本与社区样本的分支比例没有显著差异,但严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的分支比例存在差异:分支21J(Delta)和21K(Omicron BA.1)在社区样本中更为常见,而分支22B(Omicron BA.5)在临床样本中更为常见。 [10.64898/2026.11.11.26367863]
十二项研究符合纳入标准。对科学和政府机构的信任始终预测了对 NPIs 的依从性以及接种疫苗的意愿。瑞典依赖自愿措施在机构信任度高的情况下是有效的,而英国信息传达不一致导致依从性下降和公众不满。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129337]

在Omicron波期间,与Alpha波前时期相比,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR有所上升,调整后的上升幅度分别为0-4岁儿童27.6个百分点和5-11岁儿童21.3个百分点。在Alpha波和Alpha波前时期,儿童索引病例的二次传播几率低于19-64岁索引病例,但在Omicron波期间,几率则更高。接触者在不同分析时期中的年龄特异性易感性也有所不同。 [10.1016/j.resinv.2026.101537]
本研究报告指出,在奥密克戎时期,Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区的医疗工作者中发生了 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染,部分病例显示为再感染。疫苗 有效性被提及,但未在提供的证据中量化。 [10.3390/v18111258]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.headline_en: Recent Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: In the overall cohort, vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration (9.05 vs 10.42 days; P < .001) compared with unvaccinated patients. The matched cohort included 228 unvaccinated, 228 inactivated vaccine recipients, and 114 Ad5-nCoV recipients. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2731694]

Clade proportions did not differ between clinical and community samples for RSV or influenza, but differed for SARS-CoV-2: clades 21J (Delta) and 21K (Omicron BA.1) were more frequent in community samples and clade 22B (Omicron BA.5) in clinical samples. [10.64898/2026.11.11.26367863]

Of 1,598 HCWs screened, 1,334 (83.4%) were enrolled and 1,331 (83.3%) completed follow-ups. Thirteen participants developed confirmed SARS-CoV-2 reinfection, yielding a cumulative incidence of 9.7 per 1,000 individuals and an incidence density of 2.97 per 100,000 person-days (95% CI: 1.73-5.11). [10.1016/j.ijid.2026.109249]
Twelve studies met the inclusion criteria. Trust in scientific and governmental authorities consistently predicted adherence to NPIs and willingness to vaccinate. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129337]

Household SAR during the Omicron period among pediatric index cases increased compared with the pre-Alpha period, with adjusted increases of 27.6 and 21.3 percentage points in children aged 0-4 and 5-11 years, respectively. [10.1016/j.resinv.2026.101537]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期SARS-CoV-2研究集中呈现以下进展。
在总体队列研究中,接种疫苗的患者病毒清除时间显著短于未接种疫苗的患者(9.05 vs 10.42天;P < .001)。匹配后的队列研究包括228例未接种疫苗者、228例灭活疫苗接种者和114例Ad5-nCoV接种者。各组的病毒清除中位时间分别为9.42天、8.56天和8.48天。
对于RSV和流感,临床样本与社区样本的分支比例没有显著差异,但严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的分支比例存在差异:分支21J(Delta)和21K(Omicron BA.1)在社区样本中更为常见,而分支22B(Omicron BA.5)在临床样本中更为常见。
十二项研究符合纳入标准。对科学和政府机构的信任始终预测了对 NPIs 的依从性以及接种疫苗的意愿。瑞典依赖自愿措施在机构信任度高的情况下是有效的,而英国信息传达不一致导致依从性下降和公众不满。
在Omicron波期间,与Alpha波前时期相比,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR有所上升,调整后的上升幅度分别为0-4岁儿童27.6个百分点和5-11岁儿童21.3个百分点。在Alpha波和Alpha波前时期,儿童索引病例的二次传播几率低于19-64岁索引病例,但在Omicron波期间,几率则更高。接触者在不同分析时期中的年龄特异性易感性也有所不同。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
In the overall cohort, vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration (9.05 vs 10.42 days; P < .001) compared with unvaccinated patients.

Clade proportions did not differ between clinical and community samples for RSV or influenza, but differed for SARS-CoV-2: clades 21J (Delta) and 21K (Omicron BA.1) were more frequent in community samples and clade 22B (Omicron BA.5) in clinical samples.
Of 1,598 HCWs screened, 1,334 (83.4%) were enrolled and 1,331 (83.3%) completed follow-ups.
Twelve studies met the inclusion criteria. Trust in scientific and governmental authorities consistently predicted adherence to NPIs and willingness to vaccinate. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129337].

papers.title: Effects of COVID-19 vaccination type and vaccination-infection interval on viral clearance dynamics in Omicron BA.5 patients at Guangzhou Fangcang shelter hospitals: A propensity score matched multicenter retrospective cohort study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Omicron BA.5 subvariant exhibited pronounced immune evasion and was associated with widespread breakthrough infections. Unlike settings where mRNA vaccines predominated, China mainly used inactivated vaccines, with the adenovirus type 5-vectored vaccine Ad5-nCoV also administered at scale. Real-world evidence on post-infection viral clearance associated with these platforms remains limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled 16,533 mild or asymptomatic Omicron BA.5 cases from two Fangcang shelter hospitals in Guangzhou, China, from Novernber 5 to December 8, 2022. The primary objective was to compare viral-clearance time between unvaccinated and vaccinated participants. The secondary objective was to compare inactivated-vaccine recipients, or and Ad5-nCoV recipients, containing regimens in a propensity score-matched cohort; the last-dose-to-infection interval analysis was exploratory. Propensity score matching was performed using age, sex, marital status, occupation, and province as covariates to improve between-group comparability. All patients underwent standardized daily RT-PCR testing containing both N and ORF1ab genes, with Ct values > 35 defined as negative. The outcome was time to viral clearance, defined as two consecutive negative nasopharyngeal swabs ≥ 24 hours apart. In the overall cohort, vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration (9.05 vs... 10.42d; P < .001) compared with unvaccinated patients. The matched cohort included 228 unvaccinated, 228 inactivated vaccine recipients, and 114 Ad5-nCoV recipients. Median time to viral clearance differed across groups with 9.42, 8.56, and 8.48d, respectively. Prior vaccination was associated with shorter viral clearance but with no significant difference observed between inactivated vaccine and Ad5-nCoV recipients among the matched regimens.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the effects of different vaccination types and the interval between vaccination and infection on viral clearance dynamics in patients infected with the Omicron BA.5 subvariant of SARS-CoV-2.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled 16,533 mild or asymptomatic Omicron BA.5 cases from two Fangcang shelter hospitals in Guangzhou, China, from November 5 to December 8, 2022. The study compared viral clearance time between unvaccinated and vaccinated participants, with a secondary objective to compare inactivated vaccine recipients and Ad5-nCoV recipients.
analysis.methods: Propensity score matching was used to ensure comparability between groups, with age, sex, marital status, occupation, and province as covariates. Patients underwent standardized daily RT-PCR testing targeting both N and ORF1ab genes, with Ct values > 35 defined as negative. Viral clearance was defined as two consecutive negative nasopharyngeal swabs ≥ 24 hours apart.
analysis.main_results: In the overall cohort, vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration (9.05 vs 10.42 days; P < .001) compared with unvaccinated patients. The matched cohort included 228 unvaccinated, 228 inactivated vaccine recipients, and 114 Ad5-nCoV recipients. Median time to viral clearance differed across groups with 9.42, 8.56, and 8.48 days, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that prior vaccination was associated with shorter viral clearance time, but there was no significant difference observed between inactivated vaccine and Ad5-nCoV recipients among the matched regimens. This study provides novel insights into the impact of vaccination type on viral clearance dynamics in Omicron BA.5 patients.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for vaccine selection and timing in the context of Omicron BA.5 infections, particularly in regions where inactivated vaccines are predominantly used.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for confounding factors, although propensity score matching was used to improve comparability. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the effects of vaccination type and the interval between vaccination and infection on viral clearance dynamics in patients infected with the Omicron BA.5 subvariant of SARS-CoV-2. Conducted in Guangzhou Fangcang shelter hospitals from November 5 to December 8, 2022, the multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled 16,533 mild or asymptomatic cases. Propensity score matching was used to compare unvaccinated, inactivated vaccine recipients, and Ad5-nCoV recipients. Results showed that vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration compared to unvaccinated patients, but no significant difference was observed between inactivated vaccine and Ad5-nCoV recipients. The findings suggest that prior vaccination may influence viral clearance time, which could inform vaccine strategies in regions where these vaccines are predominantly used. However, the study's retrospective design and potential confounding factors limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

papers.title_zh: Effects of COVID-19 vaccination type and vaccination-infection interval on viral clearance dynamics in Omicron BA.5 patients at Guangzhou Fangcang shelter hospitals: A propensity score matched multicenter retrospective cohort study
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT The Omicron BA.5 subvariant exhibited pronounced immune evasion and was associated with widespread breakthrough infections. Unlike settings where mRNA vaccines predominated, China mainly used inactivated vaccines, with the adenovirus type 5-vectored vaccine Ad5-nCoV also administered at scale. Real-world evidence on post-infection viral clearance associated with these platforms remains limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled 16,533 mild or asymptomatic Omicron BA.5 cases from two Fangcang shelter hospitals in Guangzhou, China, from Novernber 5 to December 8, 2022. The primary objective was to compare viral-clearance time between unvaccinated and vaccinated participants. The secondary objective was to compare inactivated-vaccine recipients, or and Ad5-nCoV recipients, containing regimens in a propensity score-matched cohort; the last-dose-to-infection interval analysis was exploratory. Propensity score matching was performed using age, sex, marital status, occupation, and province as covariates to improve between-group comparability. All patients underwent standardized daily RT-PCR testing containing both N and ORF1ab genes, with Ct values > 35 defined as negative. The outcome was time to viral clearance, defined as two consecutive negative nasopharyngeal swabs ≥ 24 hours apart. In the overall cohort, vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration (9.05 vs... 10.42d; P < .001) compared with unvaccinated patients. The matched cohort included 228 unvaccinated, 228 inactivated vaccine recipients, and 114 Ad5-nCoV recipients. Median time to viral clearance differed across groups with 9.42, 8.56, and 8.48d, respectively. Prior vaccination was associated with shorter viral clearance but with no significant difference observed between inactivated vaccine and Ad5-nCoV recipients among the matched regimens.

papers.title: Reinfection with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS CoV-2) among healthcare workers in India.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Healthcare workers (HCWs) remain at heightened risk of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection due to sustained occupational exposure. The emergence of the Omicron variant, characterized by increased transmissibility and immune escape, had led to a rise in reinfections despite prior infection and vaccination. However, evidence on reinfection dynamics among HCWs in India remains limited. METHODS: A multicentric prospective cohort study was conducted across 11 tertiary care hospitals in India between December 2021 and March 2023. HCWs with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection were enrolled retrospectively (within 4 weeks prior) and prospectively (8-month follow-up. Reinfection was defined using epidemiological criteria and confirmed by whole-genome sequencing wherever paired samples were available. Socio-demographic, clinical, exposure, immunological, and laboratory data were collected using standardized case report forms. Reinfection incidence was estimated, and bivariate analysis was performed to identify factors associated with reinfection. RESULTS: Of 1,598 HCWs screened, 1,334 (83.4%) were enrolled and 1,331 (83.3%) completed follow-ups. Thirteen participants developed confirmed SARS-CoV-2 reinfection, yielding a cumulative incidence of 9.7 per 1,000 individuals and an incidence density of 2.97 per 100,000 person-days (95% CI: 1.73-5.11). The median interval between infection episodes was 193 days (IQR: 183-211). All reinfection cases were symptomatic but mild, with no hospitalizations or requirement for oxygen therapy. Whole-genome sequencing identified predominant circulation of Delta and Omicron lineages, with complete paired genome sequences confirming reinfection with genetically distinct. Although reinfection was more frequent among HCWs working in COVID-19 care areas (OR = 1.93; 95% CI: 0.63-5.95) and those aged ≥60 years (OR = 2.28; 95% CI: 0.29-18.15), these associations were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: SARS-CoV-2 reinfection occurred among HCWs during the Omicron-dominant period, with moderate incidence and predominantly mild clinical outcomes. Occupational exposure and recent contact history may contribute to reinfection risk. These findings underscore the importance of sustained infection prevention strategies and continued vaccination efforts to mitigate disease severity in high-risk populations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated reinfection rates with SARS-CoV-2 among healthcare workers in India during the Omicron-dominant period. Conducted across 11 tertiary care hospitals between December 2021 and March 2023, the research enrolled 1,334 HCWs and followed them for 8 months. Reinfection was defined using epidemiological criteria and confirmed by whole-genome sequencing where possible. Thirteen participants experienced confirmed reinfection, with a cumulative incidence of 9.7 per 1,000 individuals and an incidence density of 2.97 per 100,000 person-days. All reinfections were mild, with no hospitalizations or need for oxygen therapy. The study found no statistically significant associations between reinfection and factors such as working in COVID-19 care areas or age ≥60 years. The authors concluded that reinfection occurred during the Omicron period, with moderate incidence and mild outcomes, highlighting the need for ongoing infection prevention and vaccination efforts. However, the study's limitations include the absence of a control group and randomization, which may affect the strength of the evidence.

papers.title_zh: 印度医护人员中严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2)的再感染情况
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Healthcare workers (HCWs) remain at heightened risk of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection due to sustained occupational exposure. The emergence of the Omicron variant, characterized by increased transmissibility and immune escape, had led to a rise in reinfections despite prior infection and vaccination. However, evidence on reinfection dynamics among HCWs in India remains limited. METHODS: A multicentric prospective cohort study was conducted across 11 tertiary care hospitals in India between December 2021 and March 2023. HCWs with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection were enrolled retrospectively (within 4 weeks prior) and prospectively (8-month follow-up. Reinfection was defined using epidemiological criteria and confirmed by whole-genome sequencing wherever paired samples were available. Socio-demographic, clinical, exposure, immunological, and laboratory data were collected using standardized case report forms. Reinfection incidence was estimated, and bivariate analysis was performed to identify factors associated with reinfection. RESULTS: Of 1,598 HCWs screened, 1,334 (83.4%) were enrolled and 1,331 (83.3%) completed follow-ups. Thirteen participants developed confirmed SARS-CoV-2 reinfection, yielding a cumulative incidence of 9.7 per 1,000 individuals and an incidence density of 2.97 per 100,000 person-days (95% CI: 1.73-5.11). The median interval between infection episodes was 193 days (IQR: 183-211). All reinfection cases were symptomatic but mild, with no hospitalizations or requirement for oxygen therapy. Whole-genome sequencing identified predominant circulation of Delta and Omicron lineages, with complete paired genome sequences confirming reinfection with genetically distinct. Although reinfection was more frequent among HCWs working in COVID-19 care areas (OR = 1.93; 95% CI: 0.63-5.95) and those aged ≥60 years (OR = 2.28; 95% CI: 0.29-18.15), these associations were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: SARS-CoV-2 reinfection occurred among HCWs during the Omicron-dominant period, with moderate incidence and predominantly mild clinical outcomes. Occupational exposure and recent contact history may contribute to reinfection risk. These findings underscore the importance of sustained infection prevention strategies and continued vaccination efforts to mitigate disease severity in high-risk populations.

papers.title: Changes in age-specific patterns of household transmission of SARS-CoV-2 over six epidemic waves in 2020–2022: a population-based study in Japan
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Household transmission is a major driver of SARS-CoV-2 spread; however, longitudinal data comparing household transmission patterns across variant-specific waves remain limited. We aimed to compare household secondary attack rates (SARs) across epidemic waves and identify factors associated with household transmission. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used the JMDC Claims Database, a nationwide health insurance claims database in Japan. Six epidemic waves from January 2020 to May 2022 were defined based on temporal trends in reported COVID-19 cases and grouped into four analytical periods according to predominant variants. Index cases were defined as the first diagnosed household member per period. Household SAR was the proportion of household contacts diagnosed within 1-10 days of the index case. Period differences were estimated using linear regression models. Factors associated with household transmission were examined using multivariable mixed-effects logistic regression models. RESULTS: Analyzing 124,136 index cases and 287,886 contacts, household SAR during the Omicron period among pediatric index cases increased compared with the pre-Alpha period, with adjusted increases of 27.6 and 21.3 percentage points in children aged 0-4 and 5-11 years, respectively. In the pre-Alpha and Alpha periods, child index cases had lower odds of secondary transmission than index cases aged 19-64 years, whereas odds were higher in the Omicron period. Age-specific susceptibility among contacts also varied across analytical periods. CONCLUSIONS: Household transmission patterns changed across waves, marked by increased SARs among pediatric index cases during the Omicron period. These findings inform age-adapted public health strategies for future respiratory-viral pandemics.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,利用日本的JMDC保险索赔数据库,分析了2020年1月至2022年5月期间六波疫情中的124,136例索引病例和287,886例接触者,根据主要变异株划分为四个分析时期。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究将每个时期中首次确诊的家庭成员定义为索引病例,并将家庭SAR定义为索引病例确诊后1-10天内家庭接触者被确诊的比例。使用线性回归模型估计各时期之间的差异,并使用多变量混合效应逻辑回归模型分析与家庭传播相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 在Omicron波期间,与Alpha波前时期相比,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR有所上升,调整后的上升幅度分别为0-4岁儿童27.6个百分点和5-11岁儿童21.3个百分点。在Alpha波和Alpha波前时期,儿童索引病例的二次传播几率低于19-64岁索引病例,但在Omicron波期间,几率则更高。接触者在不同分析时期中的年龄特异性易感性也有所不同。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,不同疫情波次中家庭传播的模式发生了变化,特别是在Omicron波期间,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR显著增加,这提示未来呼吸道病毒大流行中需要采取年龄适应性的公共卫生策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来呼吸道病毒大流行中的年龄适应性公共卫生策略提供了依据,强调了理解特定变异株传播模式的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖保险索赔数据,可能无法涵盖所有病例,且可能存在未测量的混杂因素。由于研究的观察性质,其证据强度为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:家庭传播是严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2传播的主要驱动因素;然而,关于不同变异株波次中家庭传播模式的纵向数据仍然有限。我们旨在比较不同疫情波次中的家庭二次攻击率(SARs),并确定与家庭传播相关的因素。方法:本研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,使用了日本全国性的JMDC保险索赔数据库。根据报告的新型冠状病毒感染病例的时间趋势,将2020年1月至2022年5月的六波疫情划分为四个分析时期。每个时期中,首次确诊的家庭成员被定义为索引病例。家庭SAR是索引病例确诊后1-10天内家庭接触者被确诊的比例。使用线性回归模型估计各时期之间的差异。使用多变量混合效应逻辑回归模型分析与家庭传播相关的因素。结果:分析了124,136例索引病例和287,886例接触者,发现与Alpha波前时期相比,Omicron波期间儿童索引病例的家庭SAR有所上升,调整后的上升幅度分别为0-4岁儿童27.6个百分点和5-11岁儿童21.3个百分点。在Alpha波和Alpha波前时期,儿童索引病例的二次传播几率低于19-64岁索引病例,但在Omicron波期间,几率则更高。接触者在不同分析时期中的年龄特异性易感性也有所不同。结论:不同疫情波次中家庭传播的模式发生了变化,特别是在Omicron波期间,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR显著增加。这些发现为未来呼吸道病毒大流行中的年龄适应性公共卫生策略提供了依据。
papers.summary_zh: 背景:家庭传播是严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2传播的主要驱动因素;然而,关于不同变异株波次中家庭传播模式的纵向数据仍然有限。我们旨在比较不同疫情波次中的家庭二次攻击率(SARs),并确定与家庭传播相关的因素。方法:本研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,使用了日本全国性的JMDC保险索赔数据库。根据报告的新型冠状病毒感染病例的时间趋势,将2020年1月至2022年5月的六波疫情划分为四个分析时期。每个时期中,首次确诊的家庭成员被定义为索引病例。家庭SAR是索引病例确诊后1-10天内家庭接触者被确诊的比例。使用线性回归模型估计各时期之间的差异。使用多变量混合效应逻辑回归模型分析与家庭传播相关的因素。结果:分析了124,136例索引病例和287,886例接触者,发现与Alpha波前时期相比,Omicron波期间儿童索引病例的家庭SAR有所上升,调整后的上升幅度分别为0-4岁儿童27.6个百分点和5-11岁儿童21.3个百分点。在Alpha波和Alpha波前时期,儿童索引病例的二次传播几率低于19-64岁索引病例,但在Omicron波期间,几率则更高。接触者在不同分析时期中的年龄特异性易感性也有所不同。结论:不同疫情波次中家庭传播的模式发生了变化,特别是在Omicron波期间,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR显著增加。这些发现为未来呼吸道病毒大流行中的年龄适应性公共卫生策略提供了依据。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较不同流行波次中家庭次级感染率(SARs)的差异,并确定与家庭传播相关的因素,以解决对特定变异株流行波次中家庭严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2模式的纵向数据有限的问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,利用日本的JMDC保险索赔数据库,分析了2020年1月至2022年5月期间六波疫情中的124,136例索引病例和287,886例接触者,根据主要变异株划分为四个分析时期。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究将每个时期中首次确诊的家庭成员定义为索引病例,并将家庭SAR定义为索引病例确诊后1-10天内家庭接触者被确诊的比例。使用线性回归模型估计各时期之间的差异,并使用多变量混合效应逻辑回归模型分析与家庭传播相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在Omicron波期间,与Alpha波前时期相比,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR有所上升,调整后的上升幅度分别为0-4岁儿童27.6个百分点和5-11岁儿童21.3个百分点。在Alpha波和Alpha波前时期,儿童索引病例的二次传播几率低于19-64岁索引病例,但在Omicron波期间,几率则更高。接触者在不同分析时期中的年龄特异性易感性也有所不同。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,不同疫情波次中家庭传播的模式发生了变化,特别是在Omicron波期间,儿童索引病例的家庭SAR显著增加,这提示未来呼吸道病毒大流行中需要采取年龄适应性的公共卫生策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来呼吸道病毒大流行中的年龄适应性公共卫生策略提供了依据,强调了理解特定变异株传播模式的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖保险索赔数据,可能无法涵盖所有病例,且可能存在未测量的混杂因素。由于研究的观察性质,其证据强度为中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate primary SARS-CoV-2 infections, re-infections, and vaccine effectiveness during the Omicron transmission period among healthcare workers in Trieste and Gorizia, Northeast Italy.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in healthcare workers in Trieste and Gorizia, Northeast Italy, from 1 December 2021 to 31 May 2022. It focused on analyzing SARS-CoV-2 infections and vaccine effectiveness during the Omicron period.
analysis.methods: The study utilized data from healthcare workers, including testing and vaccination records, to assess infection rates and vaccine effectiveness. It involved tracking cases and comparing outcomes between vaccinated and unvaccinated individuals.
analysis.main_results: The study reported that SARS-CoV-2 infections occurred in healthcare workers during the Omicron period, with some cases indicating re-infections. Vaccine effectiveness was noted but not quantified in the supplied evidence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the importance of monitoring vaccine effectiveness against Omicron in healthcare workers, though the results were not detailed in the supplied text.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for monitoring and managing SARS-CoV-2 infections and vaccine effectiveness in healthcare workers during future Omicron waves.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the retraction notice, which suggests the findings may not be reliable. The evidence strength is low due to the retraction.

analysis.summary_en: This retracted study aimed to assess primary SARS-CoV-2 infections, re-infections, and vaccine effectiveness among healthcare workers in Trieste and Gorizia, Northeast Italy, during the Omicron transmission period from December 2021 to May 2022. The study design involved analyzing testing and vaccination records to evaluate infection rates and vaccine effectiveness. The main results indicated that infections occurred, with some cases of re-infection, but vaccine effectiveness was not quantified. The authors interpreted these findings as relevant for understanding the impact of Omicron on healthcare workers, though the study's reliability is questionable due to the retraction. The results may have implications for public health strategies, but the evidence strength is low due to the retraction. The study's limitations include the retraction itself, which undermines the confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 2021 年 12 月 1 日至 2022 年 5 月 31 日期间,意大利东北部 Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区医疗工作者在奥密克戎时期首次 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染、再感染及 疫苗 有效性情况。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在意大利东北部 Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区的医疗工作者中进行,时间为 2021 年 12 月 1 日至 2022 年 5 月 31 日。研究重点分析了奥密克戎时期 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染及 疫苗 有效性。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用医疗工作者的检测数据和 疫苗接种 记录,评估感染率和 疫苗 有效性。研究包括追踪病例,并比较接种疫苗与未接种疫苗个体的结局。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究报告指出,在奥密克戎时期,Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区的医疗工作者中发生了 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染,部分病例显示为再感染。疫苗 有效性被提及,但未在提供的证据中量化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调在奥密克戎时期监测 疫苗 有效性对医疗工作者的重要性,尽管提供的文本中未详细说明结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来奥密克戎波浪中监测和管理 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染及 疫苗 有效性提供公共卫生成果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于撤回通知,本研究存在局限性,表明研究结果可能不可靠。由于撤回,证据强度较低。

papers.title: [Dynamics of behavioral factors and attitudes toward vaccination in moscow during the COVID-19 pandemic: from the acute phase to adaptation].
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: The transition of the COVID-19 pandemic from the acute phase to adaptation was accompanied by changes in preventive behavior, institutional trust, emotional state and attitudes toward vaccination. OBJECTIVE: To analyze the dynamics of awareness, preventive behavior, trust, emotional state and attitudes toward vaccination among Moscow residents in 2021 compared with 2020. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The survey tool was developed by the WHO Regional Office for Europe with support from the University of Erfurt and adapted to the Moscow context. CATI was conducted using a stratified dual-frame sample. The article analyzes the 4th and 5th survey waves: February 2021 (n = 1038) and July-August 2021 (n = 998). RESULTS: By the 5th wave, adherence to most preventive measures decreased, especially social distancing, limiting contacts and using hand sanitizers. The proportion not wearing gloves increased sharply after the requirement was lifted. The mean self-assessment of emotional state decreased to 3.47 points; institutional assessments declined and vaccination attitudes became more polarized. CONCLUSIONS: Public health strategies should combine consistent scientific communication, targeted work with vaccine-hesitant groups and horizontal trust.

papers.title: COVID-19 vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions in selected European settings: a systematic review
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: COVID-19 pandemic responses in European countries relied on both vaccination campaigns and non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs). While vaccination reduced severe disease, NPIs remained necessary to limit transmission, particularly during periods of variant emergence. However, the effectiveness of these strategies depended on social trust, communication clarity, and behavioural adaptation. OBJECTIVE: To synthesize empirical evidence on shared determinants of vaccination and NPI-related behaviours, behavioural relationships between these strategies, and evidence concerning their joint epidemiological effects. METHODS: PubMed and Scopus were searched on 11 February 2025 using free-text terms for COVID-19, vaccination, and social or non-pharmaceutical measures. Eligible studies were peer-reviewed, empirical (quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-methods), conducted by authors affiliated with selected European institutions, and examined relationships between vaccination and NPIs. Studies based solely on modelling or secondary data were excluded. Data were synthesized narratively due to heterogeneity of study designs and outcomes. RESULTS: Twelve studies met inclusion criteria. Trust in scientific and governmental authorities consistently predicted adherence to NPIs and willingness to vaccinate. Sweden's reliance on voluntary measures was effective where institutional trust was high. In contrast, inconsistent communication in the United Kingdom contributed to reduced adherence and public frustration. Vaccinated individuals tended to increase social contacts, an association compatible with behavioural adaptation. A conjoint experiment examined stated vaccination preferences in relation to NPI attributes. Younger populations experienced notable psychological strain during prolonged restrictions. CONCLUSIONS: The synthesis primarily informs social and behavioural relationships involving vaccination and NPIs. Shared determinants and behavioural associations should not be interpreted as evidence of synergistic effects on infection, hospitalisation, or mortality. Future pandemic preparedness should prioritize trust-building, consistent messaging, and targeted psychosocial support for vulnerable groups.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for understanding how vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) interacted in pandemic responses across European countries, particularly during periods of variant emergence. The background highlighted that these strategies were crucial for controlling the spread of SARS-CoV-2.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This systematic review synthesized empirical evidence from twelve studies conducted in selected European countries, focusing on the behavioural relationships between vaccination and NPIs, as well as their joint epidemiological effects. The studies were conducted between 2020 and 2023.
analysis.methods: The review was conducted by searching PubMed and Scopus on 11 February 2025 using free-text terms related to SARS-CoV-2, vaccination, and social or non-pharmaceutical measures. Studies based solely on modelling or secondary data were excluded.
analysis.main_results: Twelve studies met the inclusion criteria. Trust in scientific and governmental authorities consistently predicted adherence to NPIs and willingness to vaccinate. Sweden's reliance on voluntary measures was effective where institutional trust was high, while inconsistent communication in the United Kingdom led to reduced adherence and public frustration.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that trust in authorities and consistent communication were key factors influencing the effectiveness of both vaccination and NPIs. This finding highlights the importance of social determinants in pandemic response strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for future pandemic preparedness to prioritize trust-building, consistent messaging, and targeted psychosocial support for vulnerable groups, particularly in maintaining adherence to public health measures.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence was synthesized narratively due to the heterogeneity of study designs and outcomes, which limits the ability to draw statistically robust conclusions. The confidence in the findings is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines the interplay between vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) in European countries during the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights that trust in scientific and governmental authorities significantly influenced adherence to NPIs and vaccination willingness. The study found that Sweden's voluntary approach was effective in high-trust settings, while inconsistent communication in the UK reduced public compliance. The review emphasizes the importance of social determinants in pandemic response strategies and suggests that future preparedness should focus on building trust and consistent messaging. However, the narrative synthesis of heterogeneous study designs limits the strength of the evidence, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 疫苗接种 与非药物干预措施(NPIs)在欧洲各国大流行应对中的相互作用,特别是在变异株出现期间。背景指出,这些策略对于控制 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 的传播至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本系统综述综合了十二项在选定欧洲国家进行的实证研究,重点探讨了 疫苗接种 与 NPIs 之间的行为关系,以及它们联合的流行病学效应。研究时间跨度为 2020 年至 2023 年。
elements_zh.methods: 综述通过于 2025 年 2 月 11 日在 PubMed 和 Scopus 上使用与 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、疫苗接种 以及社会或非药物措施相关的自由文本术语进行检索。仅基于建模或次级数据的研究被排除。
elements_zh.main_results: 十二项研究符合纳入标准。对科学和政府机构的信任始终预测了对 NPIs 的依从性以及接种疫苗的意愿。瑞典依赖自愿措施在机构信任度高的情况下是有效的,而英国信息传达不一致导致依从性下降和公众不满。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,对机构的信任和信息传达的一致性是影响 疫苗接种 和 NPIs 有效性的重要因素。这一发现突显了社会决定因素在大流行应对策略中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,未来的大流行准备应优先考虑建立信任、保持信息一致性和为弱势群体提供有针对性的心理社会支持,特别是在维持公共卫生措施依从性方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究设计和结果的异质性,证据采用叙述性方式进行综合,这限制了统计上稳健结论的得出。研究结果的可信度中等。

papers.title: Genomic diversity of respiratory pathogens in clinical versus community surveillance: a comparative analysis of SARS-CoV-2, RSV, and influenza viruses in Washington State
papers.abstract: Background: Genomic surveillance of respiratory viruses typically relies on sequences from individuals seeking health care, and whether these sequences represent the viruses circulating in the community is not well-characterized. We aimed to compare the diversity, proportion, and dynamics of influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2 between clinical and community samples. Methods In this retrospective comparative genomic analysis, we used whole-genome sequences from community-based surveillance studies in the Seattle area, and clinical sequences from the Washington State Department of Health. We compared clade proportions and dynamics, sequence-cluster diversity, non-synonymous mutations, and Ct values between clinical and community samples. Findings We analyzed 538 RSV sequences collected between 2019 and 2021 (278 community, 260 clinical), 1506 influenza sequences (260 community, 1246 clinical) between 2019 and 2020, and 8660 SARS-CoV-2 sequences (5923 community, 2737 clinical) from 2020 to 2022. Clade proportions did not differ between clinical and community samples for RSV or influenza, but differed for SARS-CoV-2: clades 21J (Delta) and 21K (Omicron BA.1) were more frequent in community samples and clade 22B (Omicron BA.5) in clinical samples. SARS-CoV-2 clinical sequence clusters were more diverse than community clusters, whereas RSV and influenza showed no significant difference. Several spike mutations associated with monoclonal antibody resistance were more prevalent in community samples for SARS-CoV-2. Ct values were lower in clinical samples for multiple SARS-CoV-2, RSV, and influenza clades. Interpretation Seasonal respiratory viruses had similar dynamics and diversity in clinical and community samples, whereas pandemic SARS-CoV-2 differed between settings. Genomic surveillance programs should combine clinical and community sampling, particularly during pandemics in order to better capture viral diversity.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:呼吸道病毒的基因组监测通常依赖于寻求医疗帮助的个体的序列,这些序列是否代表社区中流行的病毒尚不明确。我们旨在比较流感、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)和严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2在临床样本和社区样本中的多样性、比例和动态变化。方法:在本回顾性比较基因组分析中,我们使用了来自西雅图地区基于社区的监测研究的全基因组序列,以及来自华盛顿州卫生部的临床序列。我们比较了临床样本和社区样本之间的分支比例和动态变化、序列簇多样性、非同义突变以及Ct值。结果:我们分析了2019年至2021年间收集的538个RSV序列(278个社区样本,260个临床样本)、2019年至2020年间收集的1506个流感序列(260个社区样本,1246个临床样本),以及2020年至2022年间收集的8660个严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2序列(5923个社区样本,2737个临床样本)。对于RSV和流感,临床样本与社区样本的分支比例没有显著差异,但严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的分支比例存在差异:分支21J(Delta)和21K(Omicron BA.1)在社区样本中更为常见,而分支22B(Omicron BA.5)在临床样本中更为常见。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的临床序列簇比社区序列簇更具多样性,而RSV和流感则没有显著差异。对于严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2,与单克隆抗体抗性相关的多个刺突蛋白突变在社区样本中更为普遍。多个严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、RSV和流感分支的临床样本Ct值均低于社区样本。解释:季节性呼吸道病毒在临床样本和社区样本中的动态变化和多样性相似,而大流行期间的严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2则在不同环境中存在差异。基因组监测项目应结合临床和社区样本采集,特别是在大流行期间,以更好地捕捉病毒的多样性。

papers.title: Outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic: decline of functional independence and frailty
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza remains a heavy burden to the elderly and the situation has been affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The objective of this study was to clarify outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic. METHODS: The clinical data of patients 65 years of age or older who were severely ill with influenza and required hospitalization in one center were gathered between September 2023 and March 2026 (3 influenza seasons after the COVID-19 pandemic). The outcomes, functional independence, and frailty of them were analyzed. RESULTS: A total of 210 elderly patients were enrolled. The median age was 79 and 32 cases were judged as having mild or more frailty by the clinical frailty scale (CFS) before admission. Pneumonia was the most common disease indicated as cause for hospitalization, followed by a poor general condition and heart failure. The median duration of hospitalization was 13 days and in-hospital deaths were recorded for 17 patients (8.1%). Sixty cases changed hospital due to further treatment or deterioration of activity of daily living, and the functional independence measure (FIM) of 37 cases (17.6%) remained under a score of 70 even after rehabilitation. The CFSs worsened in 19 cases (9.0%) at the time of discharge. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza infection remains a heavy burden among the elderly after the COVID-19 pandemic. The elderly tend to lose functional independence and fail to frailty even after recovery from acute illness. Preventive measures for influenza to avoid admission, including vaccination, will be essential. (Influenza Internet Survey, UMIN000015989).

analysis.summary_en: This review article examines the outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights that influenza remains a significant burden for the elderly, with pneumonia being the most common cause for hospitalization. The study reports that 8.1% of patients experienced in-hospital deaths, and 17.6% of cases had functional independence scores below 70 even after rehabilitation. The clinical frailty scale (CFS) showed worsening in 9.0% of cases at discharge. The findings emphasize the need for preventive measures, such as vaccination, to reduce the risk of influenza-related hospitalizations among the elderly.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:流感仍然是老年人群的沉重负担,且这一情况受到了新型冠状病毒感染大流行的影响。本研究的目的是明确新型冠状病毒感染大流行后住院老年流感患者的预后。方法:收集了2023年9月至2026年3月期间(新型冠状病毒感染大流行后3个流感季节)某中心65岁及以上严重流感患者需要住院的临床数据。分析了这些患者的预后、功能独立性和虚弱情况。结果:共纳入210名老年患者。中位年龄为79岁,入院前根据临床虚弱量表(CFS)判断有32例为轻度或更严重的虚弱。肺炎是住院最常见的原因,其次是总体状况差和心力衰竭。中位住院时间为13天,记录了17例住院期间死亡(占8.1%)。60例因进一步治疗或日常生活活动能力恶化而转院,且在康复后,37例(17.6%)的功能独立性量表(FIM)得分仍低于70。19例(9.0%)在出院时CFS有所恶化。结论:流感感染在新型冠状病毒感染大流行后仍然是老年人群的沉重负担。即使从急性疾病中恢复,老年人仍倾向于失去功能独立性并出现虚弱。预防流感以避免住院的措施,包括疫苗接种,将是至关重要的。(流感互联网调查,UMIN000015989)

papers.title: Insights from SARS-CoV-2 nanopore genomic surveillance in Edo State, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Abstract In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, local SARS-CoV-2 nanopore sequencing capacity was established at Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (ISTH), a Lassa fever reference centre based in Edo State, Nigeria. This was enabled through training of local staff in Nigeria and Guinea in both laboratory and bioinformatic SARS-CoV-2 sequencing protocols. Between March 2020 and December 2023, the laboratory at ISTH conducted 29,643 diagnostic tests for SARS-CoV-2, of which 4,575 (15.4%) were positive. Between April and December 2022, 410 SARS-CoV-2 positive samples were selected and retrospectively sequenced in 19 runs. From these, 213 near-complete (> 93%) viral genomes were generated and submitted to GISAID. Phylogenetic and phylogeographic analyses supported that Nigeria served simultaneously as a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, driving global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe. Here we show that a pre-existing long-term laboratory capacity development program for Lassa virus, a high-risk pathogen, facilitated the successful integration of novel workflows for a new emerging pathogen.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the role of Nigeria in the global spread of SARS-CoV-2 lineages through genomic surveillance, addressing the need for improved understanding of viral transmission dynamics in the region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective genomic surveillance study was conducted at Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (ISTH) in Edo State, Nigeria, using 410 SARS-CoV-2 positive samples collected between April and December 2022.
analysis.methods: The study involved training local staff in Nigeria and Guinea on laboratory and bioinformatic SARS-CoV-2 sequencing protocols, and sequencing 410 positive samples to generate 213 near-complete viral genomes.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic and phylogeographic analyses revealed that Nigeria acted as both a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, contributing to the global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate the utility of existing laboratory infrastructure for emerging pathogens, highlighting the importance of long-term capacity development for rapid response to outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform surveillance strategies and highlight the interconnectedness of viral spread across regions, supporting targeted public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential biases in sample selection, but the evidence is strong due to the comprehensive genomic data and clear phylogenetic analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents insights from SARS-CoV-2 nanopore genomic surveillance in Edo State, Nigeria, conducted between April and December 2022. It highlights the dual role of Nigeria as both a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, contributing to the global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe. The research underscores the importance of leveraging existing laboratory infrastructure for rapid response to emerging pathogens, demonstrating the value of long-term capacity development programs. The study's findings have significant implications for understanding viral transmission dynamics and improving public health surveillance strategies. However, the retrospective nature of the study and potential biases in sample selection may limit the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on genomic data and the absence of direct causal links.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过基因组监测了解尼日利亚在严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2谱系全球传播中的作用,以应对对该地区病毒传播动态理解不足的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在尼日利亚埃多州的伊鲁亚专科教学医院(ISTH)进行了一项回顾性基因组监测研究,使用了2022年4月至12月期间收集的410项严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2阳性样本。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究涉及在尼日利亚和几内亚对本地工作人员进行实验室和生物信息学严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2测序协议的培训,并对410项阳性样本进行测序,以生成213个近完整的病毒基因组。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育和系统地理分析表明,尼日利亚同时作为严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2谱系的来源和接收者,推动了AY.36 Delta变异株的全球传播,并从北美和欧洲接收了Omicron亚谱系(BA.1.1和BQ.1)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现展示了现有实验室基础设施在应对新兴病原体中的实用性,强调了长期能力建设对于快速响应暴发的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为监测策略提供了信息,并突显了病毒传播在不同地区的相互关联性,支持有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受到回顾性设计和样本选择潜在偏倚的限制,但由于全面的基因组数据和清晰的系统发育分析,其证据是强有力的。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective genomic surveillance study was conducted at Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (ISTH) in Edo State, Nigeria, using 410 SARS-CoV-2 positive samples collected between April and December 2022.
analysis_en.methods: The study involved training local staff in Nigeria and Guinea on laboratory and bioinformatic SARS-CoV-2 sequencing protocols, and sequencing 410 positive samples to generate 213 near-complete viral genomes.
analysis_en.main_results: Phylogenetic and phylogeographic analyses revealed that Nigeria acted as both a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, contributing to the global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate the utility of existing laboratory infrastructure for emerging pathogens, highlighting the importance of long-term capacity development for rapid response to outbreaks.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform surveillance strategies and highlight the interconnectedness of viral spread across regions, supporting targeted public health interventions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential biases in sample selection, but the evidence is strong due to the comprehensive genomic data and clear phylogenetic analysis.

papers.title_zh: 从尼日利亚埃多州严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2纳米孔测序中获得的见解
papers.source_body_en: Abstract In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, local SARS-CoV-2 nanopore sequencing capacity was established at Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (ISTH), a Lassa fever reference centre based in Edo State, Nigeria. This was enabled through training of local staff in Nigeria and Guinea in both laboratory and bioinformatic SARS-CoV-2 sequencing protocols. Between March 2020 and December 2023, the laboratory at ISTH conducted 29,643 diagnostic tests for SARS-CoV-2, of which 4,575 (15.4%) were positive. Between April and December 2022, 410 SARS-CoV-2 positive samples were selected and retrospectively sequenced in 19 runs. From these, 213 near-complete (> 93%) viral genomes were generated and submitted to GISAID. Phylogenetic and phylogeographic analyses supported that Nigeria served simultaneously as a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, driving global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe. Here we show that a pre-existing long-term laboratory capacity development program for Lassa virus, a high-risk pathogen, facilitated the successful integration of novel workflows for a new emerging pathogen.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过基因组监测了解尼日利亚在严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2谱系全球传播中的作用,以应对对该地区病毒传播动态理解不足的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在尼日利亚埃多州的伊鲁亚专科教学医院(ISTH)进行了一项回顾性基因组监测研究,使用了2022年4月至12月期间收集的410项严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2阳性样本。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究涉及在尼日利亚和几内亚对本地工作人员进行实验室和生物信息学严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2测序协议的培训,并对410项阳性样本进行测序,以生成213个近完整的病毒基因组。
analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育和系统地理分析表明,尼日利亚同时作为严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2谱系的来源和接收者,推动了AY.36 Delta变异株的全球传播,并从北美和欧洲接收了Omicron亚谱系(BA.1.1和BQ.1)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现展示了现有实验室基础设施在应对新兴病原体中的实用性,强调了长期能力建设对于快速响应暴发的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为监测策略提供了信息,并突显了病毒传播在不同地区的相互关联性,支持有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受到回顾性设计和样本选择潜在偏倚的限制,但由于全面的基因组数据和清晰的系统发育分析,其证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Electrochemiluminescence as a Transformative Diagnostic Tool for SARS-CoV-2 Variant Detection: Implications for Future Pandemic Preparedness
papers.abstract: Abstract Over the past two decades, the three major betacoronavirus outbreaks, SARS-CoV (2002), MERS-CoV (2012), and SARS-CoV-2 (2019), have resulted in millions of infections and deaths globally. SARS-CoV-2 has displayed rapid mutations, enhancing its transmissibility, immune evasion, and resistance to existing vaccines and diagnostics. For these reasons, it has been named the most notorious viral outbreak in modern history. Due to the ever-mutating Spike (S) protein, key interactions with bioreceptors have been disrupted, making conventional detection methods more challenging. To minimize viral spread and improve diagnostic accuracy, innovative biosensing technologies are critical. As such, electrochemiluminescence (ECL) offers a powerful biosensing platform for SARS-CoV-2 variant detection by combining the high sensitivity of optical detection with electrochemistry. Its advantages include culture-independent detection, low background noise, a broad dynamic range, and the ability to detect low viral concentrations. Recent advances in multiple disciplines, such as novel luminophore development, nanotechnology, lab-on-a-chip miniaturization, and AI-driven machine learning, have further enhanced its diagnostic powers. Furthermore, smartphone-integrated ECL platforms enable rapid, point-of-care testing, improving disease surveillance and outbreak response. By uniting AI with ECL biosensing, the diagnostic system can refine variant classification and predict emerging mutations, making ECL a promising candidate for the next generation of pandemic diagnostics. Despite the many advantages, there is limited research that has explored ECL for SARS-CoV-2 variant detection, which is addressed in this review. This review highlights ECL’s potential to become a gold-standard technique for detecting rapidly evolving pathogens, offering a robust and accessible solution for future infectious disease monitoring.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在过去的二十年中,三种主要的β冠状病毒暴发、SARS-CoV(2002年)和MERS-CoV(2012年),以及严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(2019年)在全球范围内引发了数百万例感染和死亡。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2表现出快速的突变,增强了其传播能力、免疫逃逸能力和对现有疫苗及诊断方法的抗性。因此,它被命名为现代历史上最臭名昭著的病毒暴发。由于刺突蛋白(S蛋白)不断发生突变,关键的与生物受体的相互作用被破坏,使得传统检测方法更加困难。为了减少病毒传播并提高诊断准确性,创新的生物传感技术至关重要。因此,电化学发光(ECL)通过结合光学检测的高灵敏度与电化学特性,为严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变种的检测提供了一种强大的生物传感平台。其优势包括无需培养即可检测、背景噪声低、动态范围广以及能够检测低病毒浓度。近年来,多个学科的最新进展,如新型发光体的开发、纳米技术、芯片实验室微型化以及人工智能驱动的机器学习,进一步增强了其诊断能力。此外,集成智能手机的ECL平台实现了快速、即时的检测,提高了疾病监测和暴发的应对能力。通过将人工智能与ECL生物传感技术结合,诊断系统可以优化变种分类并预测新兴的突变,使ECL成为下一代大流行病诊断的有前景候选技术。尽管ECL具有诸多优势,但目前针对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变种检测的研究仍较为有限,本文综述旨在解决这一问题。本文综述强调了ECL在检测快速进化的病原体方面的潜力,提供了一种强大且易于获取的解决方案,用于未来传染病的监测。

papers.title: Evolving concerns: A longitudinal content analysis of free-text reports from the UK COVID-19 Public Experiences (COPE) study cohort
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Concerns are psychological appraisals of risk that can influence how people respond to threats, including those posed by infectious diseases. The aim of this study was to characterise the evolution of concerns reported by a community cohort during the first two years of the COVID-19 pandemic. DESIGN: Content analysis of qualitative descriptions of concerns in a prospective longitudinal online survey (COVID-19 UK Public Experiences (COPE) Study). METHOD: At baseline (March/April 2020), when the UK entered its first national lockdown, 11,113 adults completed the COPE survey. Follow-up surveys were conducted at 3, 12, 18 and 24 months. Participants were recruited via the HealthWise Wales research registry and social media. Baseline surveys collected demographic and health data. All waves included an open-ended question about COVID-19 concerns. Content analysis was used to identify the frequency of concerns coded to each category and number of individuals reporting concern(s) within each category at each survey wave, as participants could report multiple concerns. RESULTS: Across five survey waves, a total of 22,971 open-text responses were received. From these, 41,569 concerns were identified and coded into six main categories of concerns: personal harm (n = 16,353 concerns coded to this category), harm to others (n = 11,464 concerns), social/economic impact (n = 6,443 concerns), preventing transmission (n = 4,838 concerns), government/media (n = 1,048 concerns), and general concerns (n = 1,423 concerns). The proportion of respondents reporting any concern declined from 75.3% at baseline to 65.8% at 24-months. Over time, the proportion of respondents reporting concerns about personal harm increased (baseline 41.8% vs. 24-months 52.7%), whereas the proportion reporting concerns about harm to others decreased (baseline 48.5% vs. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight the dynamic and multi-dimensional nature of concerns reported in this cohort during the COVID-19 pandemic. Monitoring specific concerns longitudinally during pandemics could provide valuable insights to inform communication strategies and development of public health interventions.

papers.title_zh: Evolving concerns: A longitudinal content analysis of free-text reports from the UK COVID-19 Public Experiences (COPE) study cohort
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: Concerns are psychological appraisals of risk that can influence how people respond to threats, including those posed by infectious diseases. The aim of this study was to characterise the evolution of concerns reported by a community cohort during the first two years of the COVID-19 pandemic. DESIGN: Content analysis of qualitative descriptions of concerns in a prospective longitudinal online survey (COVID-19 UK Public Experiences (COPE) Study). METHOD: At baseline (March/April 2020), when the UK entered its first national lockdown, 11,113 adults completed the COPE survey. Follow-up surveys were conducted at 3, 12, 18 and 24 months. Participants were recruited via the HealthWise Wales research registry and social media. Baseline surveys collected demographic and health data. All waves included an open-ended question about COVID-19 concerns. Content analysis was used to identify the frequency of concerns coded to each category and number of individuals reporting concern(s) within each category at each survey wave, as participants could report multiple concerns. RESULTS: Across five survey waves, a total of 22,971 open-text responses were received. From these, 41,569 concerns were identified and coded into six main categories of concerns: personal harm (n = 16,353 concerns coded to this category), harm to others (n = 11,464 concerns), social/economic impact (n = 6,443 concerns), preventing transmission (n = 4,838 concerns), government/media (n = 1,048 concerns), and general concerns (n = 1,423 concerns). The proportion of respondents reporting any concern declined from 75.3% at baseline to 65.8% at 24-months. Over time, the proportion of respondents reporting concerns about personal harm increased (baseline 41.8% vs. 24-months 52.7%), whereas the proportion reporting concerns about harm to others decreased (baseline 48.5% vs. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight the dynamic and multi-dimensional nature of concerns reported in this cohort during the COVID-19 pandemic. Monitoring specific concerns longitudinally during pandemics could provide valuable insights to inform communication strategies and development of public health interventions.

papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 Lineage Distribution and Genome Sequence Quality in Zimbabwe, November 2022 to January 2024
papers.abstract: Genomic surveillance of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) depends on sequence quality and reliable specimen linkage. We characterised lineage distribution, genome quality and clinical-data linkage in 731 genomic records from Zimbabwe dated November 2022 to January 2024. Consensus sequences were analyzed using Nextclade, and genomic metadata were linked to clinical records by exact identifiers. Clinical data were available for 697 records; median age was 37 years (interquartile range, 27–48), and 71.4% were female. Fifty-nine Pango lineage assignments and 12 Nextclade clade labels were observed. XBB.1.5 descendants accounted for 443/731 records (60.6%); the most frequent exact assignments were XBB.1.5 (36.4%) and XBB.1.5.28 (17.4%). Quality-control categories were good for 24.9%, mediocre for 42.1% and bad for 33.0%. Identical aligned consensus sequences occurred in 186 pairs involving 372 records (50.9%). Five BA.2.86-group assignments had unresolved date–lineage conflicts. XBB.1.5 descendants were the most frequently assigned group in this historical dataset. Heterogeneous sequence quality, uneven sampling and unresolved record relationships constrain temporal interpretation and preclude national prevalence estimates. The findings highlight the importance of documented specimen linkage and reproducible analysis in retrospective genomic surveillance.

papers.title: Escape at an immunodominant SARS-CoV-2 spike epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in HLA-A ⁎ 24:02 + individuals.
papers.abstract: The antiviral CD8 T cell response is critical for controlling viral infections, including SARS-CoV-2. Spike mutations can mediate escape from pre-existing T cell immunity but it remains unclear whether such variants induce variant-specific CD8 T cells. Here, we investigate the HLA-A⁎24:02-restricted immunodominant NF9/A24 epitope (S448-456) and its prevalent L452R variant (NF9-5R) in Omicron BA.5 convalescents. NF9-5R-specific CD8 T cells are not detected ex vivo or after short-term in vitro stimulation of PBMCs, despite robust responses to other epitopes. In HLA-A24 transgenic mice, NF9 is markedly more immunogenic than NF9-5R, with rare cross-reactive responses. However, in vitro priming of NF9-5R-reactive CD8 T cells enables identification of a cross-reactive TCR (12E) recognizing both peptides and cells expressing spike L452R. Although the NF9-5R peptide can thus be presented and recognized, escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, creating functional "blind spots" relevant to vaccine strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether escape from an immunodominant SARS-CoV-2 spike epitope due to mutations could be compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells, addressing a gap in understanding T cell immunity against viral variants.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on HLA-A⁎24:02 + individuals who had recovered from Omicron BA.5 infections, examining their immune responses to the NF9/A24 epitope and its L452R variant.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed CD8 T cell responses in convalescents using ex vivo and in vitro stimulation of PBMCs, and they used HLA-A24 transgenic mice to assess immunogenicity and cross-reactivity of the epitopes.
analysis.main_results: NF9-5R-specific CD8 T cells were not detected ex vivo or after short-term in vitro stimulation, despite robust responses to other epitopes. In vitro priming identified a cross-reactive TCR (12E) recognizing both the wild-type and variant peptides.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, highlighting a potential functional "blind spot" in immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 variants.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have implications for vaccine strategies, as they indicate that T cell immunity may not effectively counteract immune escape at key epitopes, necessitating further research into broader immune coverage.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and animal models, with in vivo evidence being indirect. The evidence is moderate, as it relies on immunogenicity assessments in transgenic mice and ex vivo human data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates whether CD8 T cell responses to an immunodominant SARS-CoV-2 spike epitope (NF9/A24) and its L452R variant (NF9-5R) in Omicron BA.5 convalescents can compensate for immune escape. The researchers found that NF9-5R-specific CD8 T cells were not detected ex vivo or after short-term in vitro stimulation, despite robust responses to other epitopes. In HLA-A24 transgenic mice, NF9 was more immunogenic than NF9-5R, with rare cross-reactive responses. However, in vitro priming identified a cross-reactive TCR (12E) recognizing both peptides. The authors interpret these findings as indicating that immune escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, creating functional "blind spots" relevant to vaccine strategies. The study's evidence is moderate, as it relies on animal models and ex vivo human data, with limitations in directly assessing in vivo immune responses.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在体内免疫优势表位的逃逸无法被特异性CD8 T细胞补偿,突显了免疫应答对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株可能存在的功能"盲点"。

Although the NF9-5R peptide can thus be presented and recognized, escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, creating functional "blind spots" relevant to vaccine strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 突变 CD8 T细胞反应对于控制病毒感染,包括严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2至关重要。刺突突变可以介导对现有T细胞免疫的逃逸,但尚不清楚此类变异是否能诱导特异性CD8 T细胞。在这里,我们研究了Omicron BA.5康复者中HLA-A⁎24:02限制性免疫优势的NF9/A24表位(S448-456)及其常见的L452R变异体(NF9-5R)。尽管对其他表位有强反应,但在体外短期刺激PBMCs后并未检测到针对NF9-5R的CD8 T细胞。在HLA-A24转基因小鼠中,NF9比NF9-5R显著更具免疫原性,且交叉反应性反应罕见。然而,体外激活NF9-5R反应性CD8 T细胞可识别一种交叉反应性TCR(12E),其可识别野生型和变异型肽以及表达刺突L452R的细胞。尽管NF9-5R肽可以被呈递并被识别,但在体内免疫优势表位的逃逸无法被特异性CD8 T细胞补偿,这可能形成与疫苗策略相关的功能"盲点"。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨由于突变导致的免疫优势严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2刺突表位逃逸是否能被特异性CD8 T细胞补偿,以填补对病毒变异株T细胞免疫理解的空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于感染Omicron BA.5并康复的HLA-A⁎24:02阳性个体,分析其对NF9/A24表位及其L452R变异体的免疫反应。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过体外和体内刺激PBMCs分析康复者的CD8 T细胞反应,并利用HLA-A24转基因小鼠评估表位的免疫原性和交叉反应性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 尽管对其他表位有强反应,但在体外或短期体外刺激后未检测到针对NF9-5R的CD8 T细胞。体外激活识别出一种交叉反应性TCR(12E),其可识别野生型和变异型肽。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在体内免疫优势表位的逃逸无法被特异性CD8 T细胞补偿,突显了免疫应答对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株可能存在的功能"盲点"。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对疫苗策略具有重要意义,因为它们表明T细胞免疫可能无法有效对抗关键表位的免疫逃逸,需要进一步研究更广泛的免疫覆盖。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和动物模型,体内证据是间接的。证据强度中等,因为它依赖于转基因小鼠中的免疫原性评估和体外人类数据。

papers.title: Diverse fullerene amino acids enabled by silyl ester chemistry: a platform for omicron therapeutics.
papers.abstract: A remarkably straightforward, one-step protocol affords water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates from acid chlorides and in situ formed silyl esters. This strategy matches the efficiency of advanced peptide library synthesis. Preliminary screening reveals potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 Omicron inhibitors (selectivity index >143), positioning fullerene derivatives as a variant-resilient antiviral platform.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a versatile platform for creating antiviral therapeutics against SARS-CoV-2 variants, particularly addressing the challenge of variant resistance in existing treatments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research focused on the synthesis of water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates using a one-step protocol, with preliminary screening conducted against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants.
analysis.methods: The study employed silyl ester chemistry to create fullerene-amino acid conjugates, which were then tested for their antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants through preliminary screening.
analysis.main_results: Preliminary screening demonstrated that the synthesized fullerene derivatives exhibited potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 Omicron activity with a selectivity index exceeding 143.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the results as evidence that fullerene derivatives could serve as a variant-resilient antiviral platform, offering a novel approach to combat SARS-CoV-2 Omicron.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that fullerene-based therapeutics may provide a promising strategy for developing treatments that remain effective against emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to preliminary screening, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of comprehensive testing and validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a one-step protocol for synthesizing water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates using silyl ester chemistry. The research focuses on their potential as antiviral agents against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants, with preliminary screening showing potent inhibition (selectivity index >143). The authors interpret these results as indicating that fullerene derivatives could serve as a variant-resilient antiviral platform, offering a novel approach to combat Omicron. The findings suggest a promising strategy for developing treatments effective against emerging variants, though the evidence is limited to initial screening and thus has moderate strength. The study does not provide detailed methods, outcomes, or implications for broader application, but it highlights the potential of fullerene-based therapeutics in antiviral development.

papers.title: Pericarditis in COVID-19: a focus on the paediatric population
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: COVID-19, caused by SARS-CoV-2, is primarily a respiratory illness but may cause cardiovascular complications, including pericarditis. Pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis remains uncommon and likely underreported. This review summarizes the epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, management, and outcomes of pericarditis associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection in children. METHODS: We narratively reviewed the available literature on SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis in the pediatric population, including isolated acute pericarditis, myopericarditis, pericardial effusion, cardiac tamponade, and pericardial involvement in multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). RESULTS: The true incidence of pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis remains unclear. Reported cases suggest that older children and adolescents are more commonly affected, typically presenting with chest pain, fever, dyspnea, or tachycardia, whereas younger children may exhibit nonspecific symptoms. Diagnosis relies on clinical criteria supported by electrocardiography, echocardiography, inflammatory markers, and cardiac biomarkers, with cardiac magnetic resonance imaging useful when myocardial involvement is suspected. Available evidence suggests a predominantly immune-mediated pathophysiology involving cytokine dysregulation and systemic inflammation, with limited evidence of direct viral invasion. Management is largely extrapolated from established pediatric pericarditis principles and adult data. Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and colchicine are first-line therapies, while corticosteroids or intravenous immunoglobulin may be considered in selected inflammatory or MIS-C-associated cases, and interleukin-1 blockade in refractory or recurrent disease. Most affected children recover, although severe pericardial effusion, tamponade, and recurrence have been reported. CONCLUSION: Pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis encompasses a spectrum of clinical presentations and generally carries a favorable prognosis. Nevertheless, potentially serious complications emphasize the importance of early recognition, differentiation from myocarditis and MIS-C, and structured follow-up.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis in the pediatric population, examining its epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, management, and outcomes. The central question is whether SARS-CoV-2 infection can lead to pericarditis in children and how it compares to other cardiovascular complications.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of the available literature on SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis in children, including isolated acute pericarditis, myopericarditis, pericardial effusion, cardiac tamponade, and pericardial involvement in multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). The methods section does not specify a systematic search or meta-analysis, but it outlines the approach as a narrative review.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis encompasses a spectrum of clinical presentations and generally carries a favorable prognosis. Most affected children recover, although severe pericardial effusion, tamponade, and recurrence have been reported. The pathophysiology is predominantly immune-mediated, involving cytokine dysregulation and systemic inflammation, with limited evidence of direct viral invasion.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The true incidence of pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis remains unclear. There is also a lack of consensus on the exact mechanisms of disease, with limited evidence on direct viral invasion. Additionally, the management of pediatric cases is largely extrapolated from adult data and established pediatric pericarditis principles, which may not be fully validated for this specific context.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to clarify the true incidence of pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis and to better understand its pathophysiology. There is a need for more targeted studies on the immune mechanisms and potential viral interactions. Additionally, there is a call for structured follow-up and improved differentiation from myocarditis and MIS-C to ensure accurate diagnosis and appropriate management.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis in children, highlighting its varied clinical presentations and generally favorable prognosis. The evidence suggests that the condition is immune-mediated, with limited direct viral involvement. Management strategies are largely based on adult and general pediatric guidelines, underscoring the need for more specific pediatric data. The review identifies gaps in understanding the true incidence and mechanisms of the disease, emphasizing the importance of early recognition and structured follow-up to differentiate it from other cardiac conditions such as myocarditis and MIS-C. These findings suggest a need for further research and improved diagnostic protocols in this population.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关的心包炎在儿科人群中的情况,探讨其流行病学、发病机制、临床表现、诊断、管理及预后。核心问题是严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2感染是否会导致儿童心包炎,以及其与其他心血管并发症的比较。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关心包炎现有文献的叙述性综合分析,包括孤立性急性心包炎、心肌心包炎、心包积液、心包填塞以及儿童多系统炎症综合征(MIS-C)中的心包受累情况。方法部分未明确说明系统性搜索或荟萃分析,但指出综述方法为叙述性综述。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关的心包炎具有多种临床表现形式,总体预后良好。大多数受影响的儿童能够恢复,但也有报道指出严重的心包积液、填塞和复发情况。其发病机制主要为免疫介导,涉及细胞因子失调和全身性炎症,直接病毒侵袭的证据有限。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关心包炎的确切发病率仍不清楚。此外,关于疾病的确切发病机制尚无共识,直接病毒侵袭的证据有限。另外,儿童病例的管理主要基于成人数据和已建立的儿科心包炎原则,可能未完全适用于此特定情况。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步研究以明确儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关心包炎的确切发病率,并更好地理解其发病机制。需要更多针对性的研究来探讨免疫机制和潜在的病毒相互作用。此外,呼吁进行结构化随访,并改善与心肌炎和MIS-C的鉴别诊断,以确保准确的诊断和适当的管理。

papers.title: Spiritual Health Locus of Control and COVID-19 Booster Intentions Among Hispanic Americans: A Culturally Grounded Extension of the Extended Parallel Process Model.
papers.abstract: Declining uptake of COVID-19 boosters poses significant public health concerns. Hispanic Americans, who have experienced disproportionate pandemic impacts, report lower uptake of updated boosters than non-Hispanic White adults, partly attributable to vaccine hesitancy. Although religiosity plays a central role in Hispanic communities, little is known about how spiritually grounded beliefs shape cognitive and emotional responses to vaccination. This study integrates the extended parallel process model (EPPM) with spiritual health locus of control (SHLOC) to examine how exposure to faith-based and governmental vaccine information influences booster intention through spiritually grounded efficacy appraisals. Using an online survey of Hispanic American adults ( N = 349), we tested a structural equation model linking SHLOC, perceived threat, efficacy beliefs, fear, and vaccination intentions. Results indicated that active SHLOC, reflecting beliefs in divine partnership in health, increased response efficacy and indirectly promoted booster intention and vaccine advocacy, whereas passive SHLOC, reflecting divine determinism, reduced self-efficacy and indirectly discouraged booster intention. Perceived threat was positively associated with fear, and efficacy beliefs emerged as the strongest predictors of booster intention. Mediation analyses supported serial pathways from message exposure to SHLOC to efficacy to intention, identifying spiritually grounded control beliefs as a culturally embedded mechanism in vaccine decision making. Findings suggest that faith-based engagement can function as either a protective or risk communication channel, depending on whether messages reinforce divine partnership or determinism. The study advances EPPM by identifying SHLOC as a culturally grounded antecedent to efficacy appraisal and offers implications for culturally responsive vaccine communication in Hispanic communities.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: The study examines how spiritual health locus of control (SHLOC) influences booster intentions among Hispanic Americans during the COVID-19 pandemic, with a focus on the role of faith-based and governmental vaccine information in shaping cognitive and emotional responses to vaccination.
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本研究基于对349名西班牙裔美国成年人的在线调查。采用结构方程模型将SHLOC、感知威胁、效能信念、恐惧和疫苗接种意图联系起来。研究未报告具体数据库、检索日期或纳入标准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 主动型SHLOC反映了对健康中神圣合作的信念,与反应效能增加相关,并间接促进了加强针意图和疫苗倡导行为。被动型SHLOC反映了神圣决定论,降低了自我效能,并间接抑制了加强针意图。感知威胁与恐惧呈正相关,效能信念是加强针意图最强的预测因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本研究未直接报告争议或证据缺口。然而,它承认目前对精神层面的信念如何影响对疫苗接种的认知和情感反应了解甚少,突显了在理解SHLOC在疫苗决策中的作用方面存在潜在的证据缺口。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,基于信仰的参与可以作为保护性或风险性沟通渠道,这取决于信息是否强化神圣合作或决定论。本研究为西班牙裔社区中文化敏感的疫苗沟通提供了启示。

papers.title: COVID-19 risk perceptions after the end of the public health emergency
papers.abstract: We examine how information provision affects the public's perceived COVID-19 infection risk after the official end of the pandemic as a public health emergency (PHE). We conducted our survey in Japan in August 2023, a few months after the government reclassified COVID-19 from Category II to Category V and officially ended the PHE. We find that none of the information treatments affected the public's risk perceptions in a statistically significant way, in stark contrast with a similar information-provision experiment conducted right before the reclassification. Our results are consistent with reduced public responsiveness to news about infection following the official end of the PHE.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines how information provision affects the public's perceived risk of COVID-19 infection after the official end of the public health emergency (PHE).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study was conducted in Japan in August 2023, a few months after the government reclassified COVID-19 from Category II to Category V and officially ended the PHE. The review uses a survey-based approach to assess public risk perceptions.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The findings indicate that none of the information treatments had a statistically significant effect on the public's risk perceptions of COVID-19, contrasting with a similar experiment conducted before the reclassification.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The results suggest reduced public responsiveness to news about infection following the official end of the PHE, but the evidence does not provide detailed mechanisms or broader population insights.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for further research on public risk perceptions post-PHE and the potential impact of information provision in shaping these perceptions.

analysis.summary_en: This review investigates how information provision influences public risk perceptions of COVID-19 after the official end of the public health emergency (PHE) in Japan. Conducted in August 2023, the study contrasts with a similar experiment before the PHE's reclassification. The results show no statistically significant effect of information treatments on risk perceptions, suggesting reduced public responsiveness to infection news post-PHE. The findings emphasize the importance of understanding public behavior and the role of information in shaping perceptions, with implications for future research and public health strategies.
